svg.title: Variational effective-field derivation vs additive direct spin-torque composition on the LLG RHS
svg.desc: Three-panel diagram showing (a) conservative micromagnetic energy functionals E_k[m] producing field-form contributions H_k via first variation summed into H_eff, (b) non-conservative current-driven torques T_G converted exactly once into tau_direct without pseudo-field injection, and (c) geometric vector addition in the tangent plane T_m S^2 preserving m . dm/dt = 0.
svg.text: Exchange · Demag · Zeeman · Anis · DMI · Mel
Each term owns density wk, sign & natural BC
